data_source: EV Trading Labs/Dukascopy-derived XAU/USD 15m BID/ASK, private Neon gold_research_evduka_xau15m_bidask_candidate
clock: NY17 full session, actual bar end UTC; DST-sensitive implementation SQL
base_rule: If CASH and current completed 15m MID exceeds close MID of four previous fully completed NY17 sessions by >=3%, BUY using ASK at next completed M15; if GOLD and <=-3% SELL using next M15 BID; otherwise HOLD. Month-end reference close all holdings at last full-session BID, apply 0.8% SELL
minimum_horizon: No fixed hour, every M15 closed bar of full NY17 eligible; holding period unconstrained; month-end liquidation for comparable NAV only
roundtrip_friction_plus_spread: 1/(0.992*0.992)-1=1.6194% in no-spread case; realized BID/ASK included
exit_reason: mandatory experimental month-end, not DOWN alarm
publish_note: Single simulated bid/ask fills as execution proxies, not validated bank quotes or actual trades. No proprietary raw M15 rows exported.
evaluation_limitation: Only price-only event detector scored; human/GPT economic evidence was not quantitatively fed into policy. Jan23 and 2026 known ex post. Not OOS and not a validated cost-adjusted opportunity predictor.
